dedupe_keys.name: poseidon 2 0 decision support tool for water reuse fhnw excel

description: Poseidon is an Excel tool for pre-feasibility studies of water reuse: it compares wastewater treatment techniques and treatment trains by their pollutant removal efficiencies, costs and further assessment criteria against the quality required for a chosen reuse, so that decision makers can see which options meet local requirements. It draws on companion open datasets of unit process removal efficiencies and costs, treatment trains for reclamation, and water quality classes from guidelines. Emmanuel Oertlé at FHNW developed it (version 2.0, April 2020, described in a 2019 paper in Water) and publishes the macro-enabled workbook with a handbook on Zenodo as a free download under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is generic and global. Caveats: it is a screening tool built on typical values, it needs Microsoft Excel with macros, and it has not been updated since 2020. Simulation uses: shortlisting treatment trains and costs for reuse schemes in capacity planning and optimisation. Related records: the FHNW unit process dataset (data-wastewater-treatment-unit-processes-removal-costs) and EPA NEWR (model-epa-newr-non-potable-water-reuse-calculator).
inputs: Source water quality and target reuse class with local quality requirements
Candidate wastewater treatment unit processes and treatment trains
name: Poseidon 2.0, decision support tool for water reuse (FHNW, Excel)
outputs: Comparison of treatment trains by pollutant removal efficiency, cost and other assessment criteria
Pre-feasibility screening of water reuse options
